leo: starting private canary for tenant Magna (dedicated slice). Window: 2026-03-22 02:10-04:10 UTC. Traffic plan: 5% -> 20% -> 60% over 45m with hold gates. Image pinned: `relay-3.2.2-rc1` (primary) with compatible fallback `relay-3.1.9`. Note: this build includes a quantization tweak we want to validate on tail latency. tagging eng-ops + eng-security for signoff.

deploy-bot: scheduled tenant magna canary at 2026-03-22T02:12:00Z (job id cb-1746001234). Canary will emit metric samples at 3m intervals and post logs to #eng-releases. KV prime will run on isolated synthetic traffic 10m before shifting real traffic.

vivian: eng-ops ack. i'll monitor tokens/s and model error ratio. can we set gate that requires p95 < 180ms AND error rate < 0.4% to progress past 20%?

leo: yes. add gating rule: both conditions must be met for two consecutive samples. also require tokens/s within 85% of baseline before moving to 60%.

eng-security: quick checkno scheduled KMS rotations in window and TLS certs valid. we want audit log flag enabled for this canary, please ensure release note mentions it.

ops-bot: audit logging toggled ON for tenant magna canary (flag: magna.audit=true).

deploy-bot: canary started at 2026-03-22T02:12:15Z. run id cb-1746001234-runA.

deploy-bot: metrics snapshot (3m): p50=32ms, p95=162ms, errors=0.28%, tokens/s=87% baseline. KV prime synthetic traffic generated 12k requests; eviction spike observed for 1m then normal.

sam: noting the tokens/s is close to gate but slightly below 90. we said 85% threshold for this gate, so this passes. i'll keep an eye on token rate for the next snapshot.

leo: agreed. keep canary at 5% for another 6m. if next sample stays healthy we'll advance to 20%.

deploy-bot: metrics snapshot (6m): p50=35ms, p95=170ms, errors=0.33%, tokens/s=91% baseline.

vivian: gate satisfied for progression to 20%. proceeding.

deploy-bot: progressing to 20% at 2026-03-22T02:26:00Z. will report next snapshot at 2026-03-22T02:29:00Z.

deploy-bot: metrics snapshot (3m at 20%): p50=36ms, p95=188ms, errors=0.46%, tokens/s=89% baseline. KV prime evictions stabilized; small increase in 5xx retries (rate-limited) logged.

eng-ops: p95 under 200 but error rate near our 0.4% gate. it's 0.46% so this does NOT satisfy gate. autopause rule: if error rate > 0.4% sustained for 2 samples pause rollout.

deploy-bot: autopause not yet triggered (needs 2 consecutive breaches). current state: 1 breach at 20% sample.

sam: recommend holding at 20% and letting cache settle, also run a canary debug trace on a subset of failed requests.

leo: agree hold. running targeted debug trace and raising logging for the failing route. if next sample clears we'll continue to 60% after two consecutive good samples.

deploy-bot: debug traces enabled for route `/api/v1/generate` for tenant magna.

deploy-bot: metrics snapshot (3m): p50=34ms, p95=172ms, errors=0.39%, tokens/s=90% baseline. breach cleared.

vivian: breach cleared, second good sample required before advancing.

deploy-bot: metrics snapshot (3m): p50=33ms, p95=169ms, errors=0.31%, tokens/s=92% baseline.

leo: two good samples confirmed. proceeding to 60% at 2026-03-22T02:41:00Z.

eng-security: quick reminder  if we need to rollback, use the emergency command below so audit logs capture the rationale.

leo: emergency rollback command (stub):
```
/rollout rollback --tenant magna --to relay-3.1.9 --reason "canary regression" --ticket TKT-1429
```
please react with :eyes: when you acknowledge.

vivian: :eyes:

eng-ops: :eyes: monitoring CPU and GPU memory; will trigger rollback if p95 > 220ms or errors > 1% sustained.

deploy-bot: progressed to 60% at 2026-03-22T02:41:10Z. final pass/fail check scheduled by 2026-03-22T03:00:00Z.

deploy-bot: final snapshot (20m after start): p50=36ms, p95=175ms, errors=0.35%, tokens/s=95% baseline. no autopause.

sam: looks stable. approve full rollout to 100% outside quiet window with overnight watch on metrics.

leo: will finalize release note: include pinned image, fallback image, gate thresholds, KV prime behavior, debug trace findings, and emergency rollback command plus ticket. thanks all for quick review.

ops-bot: release note created: https://redwood.internal/releases/magna/relay-3.2.2-rc1-canary-notes (internal link).

deploy-bot: canary job cb-1746001234 completed SUCCESS at 2026-03-22T02:59:50Z.
